battleline_available.note: MUTSU remains lost. Historical KON/Biak detachment does not exist, so Yamato/Musashi are already inside the Marianas battle system rather than requiring a later recombination. Hiei/Kirishima survival gives the branch a four-ship Kongo-class fast-battleship layer.

cruiser_pool_centerline.light_cruiser_command_screen: YAHAGI/NOSHIRO-class command-screen layer; exact final split remains tactical until 15-16 Jun formation closure.
cruiser_pool_centerline.guard: Names are a battle-system availability roster; no ship is double-counted into two simultaneously firing formations. Exact task-group assignment remains fluid on 14 Jun.

destroyer_screen_delta_vs_historical_mid.14Jun_centerline_additional_survivor: SHIRATSUYU survives 14 Jun; the historical Seiyo Maru collision is not inherited because branch refueling/escort timing and route geometry are different.
destroyer_screen_delta_vs_historical_mid.effect: The battle force enters the Philippine Sea with a materially deeper destroyer screen, allowing more ASW sectors, carrier plane-guard stations and torpedo-capable night detachments without stripping every carrier group.

employment_policy: No independent battleship dash to Saipan. Surface power remains carrier screen/AA concentration, submarine defense, night-battle contingency and exploitation force unless US transport/fire-support geometry presents a favorable lane.
